title: The phase overview: every ticket as a wedge in its phase's sector, finished phases on a shelf, the backlog in a tray, and the same overview as a Glass field

plates.label: The shelf: sixteen finished phases as discs, violet badges on the ones with acceptance tests owed again
968 tickets with no phase: 572 suggested from links, 74 from dates, 322 left for a person
Small webs, one per phase still to finish, then the backlog and the no-phase tickets

Glass facing PHASE-021: compass across the top, closed tickets as tiles at the horizon, open tickets in the middle band, failed and owed-again tests as large cards in front, exit criteria card front left
PHASE-021 as a Glass desk: the phase note with its exit criteria, a Features collection as cards, a Tests collection as a table, and TST-0656 opened with six neighbours

revisions.label: 2026-10-08 — written after four rounds in one session, each published to claude.ai (the two URLs in source: ). Round one drew nine unrelated overviews; Edwin kept RINGS and STARS because they tie items to a phase. Round two added ticket types, project-wide tickets and drill-down. Round three drew one wedge per ticket, ordered the rings from fewer to more, made decisions and risks project-wide, removed exit criteria as a ring, and turned the stars into webs. Round four, recorded here, moved finished phases to a shelf, drew the backlog as a tray, added re-phase suggestions and the "owed again" state, and drew the overview and a phase page as Glass.
